about_short_description.short_description: Flow.Club offers online virtual co-working sessions to motivate people to work in sprints and get twice as much done.

product.name: Virtual Coworking Sessions
product.description: Online sessions where participants work alongside others in timed intervals to enhance focus and productivity through shared accountability and structured breaks.

product.name: Body Doubling
product.description: A technique where individuals work alongside others virtually to increase motivation and task adherence by leveraging social presence and accountability.

product.name: Session Hosting and Facilitation
product.description: Volunteer-led facilitation of coworking sessions that provide structure, accountability, and focus-enhancing elements like music and goal check-ins.

product.name: Focus Music Integration
product.description: Provision of curated focus-enhancing music played during sessions to support concentration and cue work periods.

product.name: Time Management Tools and Features
product.description: Tools including visible timers, to-do lists, calendar reminders, and structured agendas to support task initiation, time blocking, and accountability.
